sources.title: distilbert-NER: Text-to-Text model — overview, use cases, alternatives
sources.snippet: distilbert-NER is a fine-tuned named entity recognition model built on DistilBERT, created by dslim. The model contains 66M parameters and identifies four entity types: location (LOC), organization (ORG), person (PER), and miscellaneous (MISC).
